name: A · 토이 팝
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: high fidelity game UI art direction sheet for the existing Korean portrait mobile game TRIO CHESS.
Output one large crisp LANDSCAPE presentation board, ideally 1800x1200 or larger, containing EXACTLY THREE complete portrait 9:16 game screens in one horizontal row, same size, no cropping, no device frames. Small restrained editorial heading above each screen: "01 로비", "02 전투", "03 장비". Each screen must be usable/readable at mobile size. This is a UI design proposal based on a REAL GAME, not a generic fantasy app.
Input images (all reference images, not images to just repeat unchanged): Image 1 = current lobby; Image 2 = current battle HUD; Image 3 = current equipment screen. Preserve their character and world identity: cute low-poly 3D trio, orange-bearded horned warrior, pink-haired green-clad ranger, purple-hat blue-robed mage, lime-green grass, tan vertical path, rounded bushes and rocks, campfire/island lobby. Keep 3D world and recognizable characters across all screens and across styles; redesign ONLY interface art direction/layout hierarchy. Do not substitute painted scenery or realistic heroes.
Core data/function invariants: gold 12,480, blue upgrade stones 86, purple time crystals 240. Lobby has TRIO CHESS logo, 3 heroes and campfire island dominant in upper middle, utility buttons 모닥불 / 출석 / 미션 / 토벌 / 탤런트, visible 장비 and 유물 entries, selected chapter "1. 햇살 왕국", big primary "출발" CTA, secondary "끝없는 행군" card. Clear scan order, one dominant CTA.
Battle has top chapter "1. 햇살 왕국", wave progress "무리 2 / 10", three small currency counters, pause button, unobscured center 3D battle field taking at least 50% of viewport height with enemies above and the trio below. No large decorative panel over enemies. Bottom action zone: SIX compact skill circles in three groups of two, THREE hero status cards (one per class, HP green / mana blue, distinct role colors), compact 7-column x2-row inventory labelled "가방 3/14", several book/equipment icons in first cells, "판매" secondary action, five-item bottom nav "상점 영웅 전투 특성 도감", active 전투. Keep bag legible, do not invent joystick, no giant attack button.
Equipment screen: header "장비" with back/close, currency gold and upgrade stone, 3 hero tabs "워리어 레인저 메이지", selected warrior. Three equipment columns "무기 방어구 장신구": sword / helmet / ring, level labels "Lv.4", "Lv.3", "Lv.2", bonus stats, upgrade cost buttons. Lower half storage 6-column x3-row grid with colorful readable item icons (sword, axe, bow, staff, helmet, ring), heading "보관함 18" and "모두 합성", selected item fixed detail area showing "일식검", rarity "전설", "공격력 +90", two short lines of effect info, primary "장착", secondary "판매". Keep grid and detail area from overlapping. It must feel dense but beautifully organized.
Common design constraints: Korean rounded sans typography, concise accurate Korean headings as specified. Large headings and primary actions readable. Use no illegible fake body text; omit tiny paragraphs instead. Rarity color blue/purple/gold reserved for item rarity consistently. Distinguish frame selection from rarity using a white check and small corner tick. Realistic touch target sizes, generous padding, coherent icon family. No fake promotion offers, gacha purchase, energy, gems purchases, new game modes, or extra systems. No debug labels or desktop hotkeys. No watermark. All three panels are same style and finished with identical component system.

Art direction A: TOY POP / 토이 팝. Warm ivory surfaces #FFF5DD, deep ink navy #243047 outlines, saturated sunflower #FFD34D primary CTA, coral #FF785E accents, turquoise #41BBA8 confirm. Premium physical toy packaging feel, playful and clean, smooth rounded corners, subtle beveled bottoms 4px, controlled 2-3px navy strokes, warm soft shadows. Flat ivory inset cards with bright polished toy item icons. All labels have clean typography, avoid heavy black strokes around EVERY letter. Nav is ivory with active yellow lifted tab. Lobby expedition card is warm ivory with yellow departure button; let bright diorama breathe. Battle HUD ivory pills and cream bottom shelf, gentle navy dividers, healthy negative space, status cards visually joined by a subtle shared shelf. Equipment background warm ivory with navy heading and uncluttered white cards; selected hero coral tab; item grid elegant soft lilac/beige recesses. The 3D game art remains current vivid lime/blue, not repainted.
Presentation board background light warm neutral, small top-left title "A / TOY POP", tiny palette swatches near title, no extra marketing prose. Strong production quality, delightful, tactile, high hierarchy.

Art direction B: FIELD JOURNAL / 모험수첩. Parchment ivory #F3E7CB, forest green #294D46, dark brown #463B30 typography, brass gold #D8A84F CTA accents, muted sage #8AAB91 support. Warm contemporary illustrated expedition journal interface, refined paper panels, stitched/pressed edges used sparingly, subtle paper grain only on large backgrounds, bookmark tabs, thin forest-green line icons, small brass corner hardware on big cards. Do NOT make medieval ornate frames, scrolls everywhere, heavy dark wood or realistic leather. Refined outdoors camp aesthetic compatible with low-poly toys. Clear forest-green primary "출발" with brass arrow. Lobby expedition card resembles a well designed field ticket with chapter number medallion; utility buttons compact enamel badges. Battle top route becomes a neat map itinerary strip while preserving information; lower HUD is a light parchment field kit shelf, forest-green status labels, accessible mana bars, skill circles like enamel pins. Equipment is a clean inventory ledger with green hero tabs, paper compartment slots, minimal brass separators, high quality colorful toy item icons in parchment cells. Grid item rarity colors are still blue purple gold, with tiny grade chips.
Presentation board background lightly warm off-white, title "B / FIELD JOURNAL", tiny palette swatches. Keep exactly same vivid 3D scene and camera as references; palette changes to UI surfaces only. Elegant calm and human, not generic casual game, not drab sepia.
Precision priority: Battle bag must contain EXACTLY 14 cells in 7 columns by 2 rows, only first THREE cells occupied, remaining eleven empty, matching 가방 3/14. All equipment upgrade cost buttons show both gold and blue stone costs. Exactly three hero cards and exactly six skills.
